import java.util.*;

public class MinCostFlow {
    static final int N = 10005;
    static final int S = N - 3;
    static final int T = N - 2;
    static final int M = 2000010;
    static final int INF = 2000000000;

    static int[] head = new int[N];
    static int[] to = new int[M];
    static int[] nxt = new int[M];
    static int[] cap = new int[M];
    static int[] cost = new int[M];
    static int edge_id = 1;

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int capacity, int cst) {
        to[++edge_id] = v;
        nxt[edge_id] = head[u];
        head[u] = edge_id;
        cap[edge_id] = capacity;
        cost[edge_id] = cst;

        to[++edge_id] = u;
        nxt[edge_id] = head[v];
        head[v] = edge_id;
        cap[edge_id] = 0;
        cost[edge_id] = -cst;
    }

    static boolean spfa(int[] dist, boolean[] in_queue) {
        Arrays.fill(in_queue, false);
        Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(T);
        dist[T] = 0;
        in_queue[T] = true;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int x = q.poll();
            in_queue[x] = false;
            for (int i = head[x]; i != 0; i = nxt[i]) {
                int y = to[i];
                if (cap[i ^ 1] > 0 && dist[y] > dist[x] + cost[i ^ 1]) {
                    dist[y] = dist[x] + cost[i ^ 1];
                    if (!in_queue[y]) {
                        q.offer(y);
                        in_queue[y] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[S] < INF;
    }

    static int dfs(int x, int flow_limit, long[] total_cost, int[] cap, int[] cost, int[] head, int[] to, int[] nxt, boolean[] in_queue, int[] dist) {
        int flow = 0;
        in_queue[x] = true;
        if (x == T) return flow_limit;
        for (int i = head[x]; i != 0; i = nxt[i]) {
            int y = to[i];
            if (cap[i] == 0 || in_queue[y]) continue;
            if (dist[x] != dist[y] + cost[i]) continue;
            int t = dfs(y, Math.min(cap[i], flow_limit - flow), total_cost, cap, cost, head, to, nxt, in_queue, dist);
            if (t > 0) {
                cap[i] -= t;
                cap[i ^ 1] += t;
                flow += t;
                total_cost[0] += (long) t * cost[i];
                if (flow == flow_limit) break;
            }
        }
        in_queue[x] = false;
        return flow;
    }

    static long minCostFlow(int n, int m, int k, int c, int d, int[] xArr, int[] yArr) {
        // Initialize arrays
        Arrays.fill(head, 0);
        edge_id = 1;

        // Add edges for k sources
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x = xArr[i] - 1;
            addEdge(S, x, 1, 0);
        }

        int limit = 101;

        // Add edges for cost layers
        for (int i = 0; i < limit; i++) {
            addEdge(i * n, T, k, c * i);
        }

        // Add edges for movement between layers
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < limit - 1; j++) {
                addEdge(i + j * n, i + (j + 1) * n, k, 0);
            }
        }

        // Add edges for m connections
        for (int idx = 0; idx < m; idx++) {
            int x = xArr[idx] - 1;
            int y = yArr[idx] - 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < limit - 1; i++) {
                for (int j = k - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
                    int costVal = d * (j * 2 + 1);
                    addEdge(x + i * n, y + (i + 1) * n, 1, costVal);
                    addEdge(y + i * n, x + (i + 1) * n, 1, costVal);
                }
            }
        }

        int total_flow = 0;
        long total_cost = 0;
        int[] dist = new int[N];
        boolean[] in_queue = new boolean[N];
        while (spfa(dist, in_queue)) {
            Arrays.fill(in_queue, false);
            total_flow += dfs(S, 101, new long[]{total_cost}, cap, cost, head, to, nxt, in_queue, dist);
        }
        return total_cost;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();

        int[] xArr = new int[k];
        int[] yArr = new int[k];

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            xArr[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            yArr[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }

        long result = minCostFlow(n, m, k, c, d, xArr, yArr);
        System.out.println(result);
        sc.close();
    }
}
